title: Talking about quantities in Procurement
grammar: Quantifiers — a few / a little / a lot of / enough
objective: Nesta aula você vai aprender a falar de quantidades usando a few, a little, a lot of e enough. Isso é essencial em Compras para descrever estoque, número de fornecedores, prazo e material disponível ao fechar um pedido de compra na Delta Ducon.
intro: In Procurement you talk about quantities every day: a few suppliers, a little time before the deadline, a lot of components, or enough material for the project.
Today we learn how to choose the right quantifier. This helps you write clear purchase orders and answer suppliers without confusion.
introAudio: Hi, I am Bruno from Procurement. Every day I talk about quantities: a few suppliers, a lot of components, and enough material for the project. Let us practise together.
vocab: We have a few reliable suppliers for filters.
I received a lot of quotations this week.
We do not have enough material for the order.
There is a little time before the deadline.
The system needs a lot of components.
We keep enough stock of spare parts.
practice: I need to send this ______ to the customer today.
There is not enough ______ for the dust filter.
We have a little time before the ______.
Each gas washing system uses every ______.
We keep enough ______ of spare parts in Diadema.
Please contact this ______ about the delivery.

audio.title: Checking quantities for a purchase order
audio.text: We have a few suppliers for this component, but only a little time before the deadline. There are a lot of quotations to compare, so I need help. Do we have enough material in stock for the emissions project? We do not have enough valves, but we have a lot of pipes. I think a few phone calls will solve the problem.

readAloud: We have a few suppliers for this filter.
There is a little time before the deadline.
We received a lot of quotations this week.
We do not have enough material in stock.
A few components are still missing.
fill: We have ___ suppliers for this part.
There is ___ time before the deadline.
We do not have ___ material in stock.
I need ___ more information about the price.
The project needs ___ valves and pipes.
Do we have ___ money in the budget?
qa: How many suppliers do we have for filters?
We have a few reliable suppliers.
Do we have enough material for the order?
No, we do not have enough material yet.
How much time is left before the deadline?
We have a little time, so we must be quick.
How many quotations did you receive?
I received a lot of quotations this week.
Is there enough stock in Diadema?
Yes, there is enough stock of spare parts.
sentences: We have a few suppliers for this component.
There is a little time before the deadline.
We received a lot of quotations this week.
We do not have enough material in stock.
A few parts are still missing from the order.
I need a little more information about the price.
The project needs a lot of valves and pipes.
Do we have enough budget for this purchase?
grammarPoint: Quantificadores dizem 'quanto'. Use a few e a lot of com contáveis (plural): a few suppliers, a lot of components. Use a little com incontáveis: a little time. Use enough para 'suficiente', com os dois. We have a few suppliers. — Temos alguns fornecedores. There is enough material. — Há material suficiente.
deepDive: A few e a little são poucos, mas positivos ('alguns', 'um pouco'). A lot of é 'muito(s)' e serve para contáveis e incontáveis. Enough vem antes do substantivo: enough material, enough valves. Dica: se você pode contar (1, 2, 3), use a few; se não pode (time, money, water), use a little.
examples: We have a few reliable suppliers.
Temos alguns fornecedores confiáveis.
There is a little time before the deadline.
Há um pouco de tempo antes do prazo.
We received a lot of quotations.
Recebemos muitas cotações.
We do not have enough material.
Não temos material suficiente.
A few components arrived late.
Alguns componentes chegaram atrasados.
I need a little more information.
Preciso de um pouco mais de informação.
The system uses a lot of valves.
O sistema usa muitas válvulas.
Do we have enough stock?
Temos estoque suficiente?
A little patience helps in negotiation.
Um pouco de paciência ajuda na negociação.
We placed a lot of orders this month.
Fizemos muitos pedidos este mês.
mistakes: a few time
a little time
Time é incontável, então use a little.
a little suppliers
a few suppliers
Suppliers é contável no plural, use a few.
We have enough of material.
We have enough material.
Enough vem direto antes do substantivo, sem of.
a lot components
a lot of components
A lot of sempre leva of antes do substantivo.
much suppliers
a lot of suppliers
Em frases afirmativas prefira a lot of a much.
quick: We have ___ suppliers for this part.

celebrate.en: Well done. Talking about quantities clearly is the heart of Procurement, and you can now do it in English.
celebrate.pt: Muito bem. Falar de quantidades com clareza é o coração de Compras, e você já sabe fazer isso em inglês.

title: Planning deliveries ahead of time
grammar: Future Continuous & Future Perfect — will be doing / will have done
objective: Nesta aula você vai aprender a falar de ações futuras em andamento (will be doing) e de ações que estarão concluídas antes de um prazo (will have done). Em Compras, isso ajuda a informar clientes e fornecedores sobre o que estará acontecendo e o que já terá sido entregue até certa data.
intro: Procurement is about the future: what will be happening next week and what will have arrived by the deadline.
Today we practise will be doing and will have done. With these forms you can plan deliveries and give clear updates to suppliers and project managers at Delta Ducon.
introAudio: Hi, I am Carla from Procurement. Next week I will be following up on three orders. By Friday, we will have received all the components. Let us learn how to say this in English.
vocab: The delivery will arrive next Monday.
I will be processing the order tomorrow.
The shipment will have left the port by Friday.
The schedule shows every delivery date.
The supplier will send the invoice soon.
The parts will arrive at the warehouse.
practice: I will be processing your ______ tomorrow morning.
The ______ will have left the port by Friday.
Please check the delivery ______ for this week.
The supplier will send the ______ after delivery.
The valves will arrive at the ______ in Diadema.
We will be tracking every ______ until it arrives.
The customer is waiting for this ______.

audio.title: A delivery update for the project team
audio.text: Next week I will be following up on the filter order with our supplier. By Wednesday, they will have shipped the components. I will be checking the schedule every day, so we will not miss anything. By the end of the month, we will have received all the parts for the gas washing system. The team will be installing them soon after. By then, the customer will have signed the final report.

readAloud: Next week I will be following up on the order.
By Friday, the supplier will have shipped the parts.
I will be checking the schedule every day.
By the end of the month, we will have received everything.
The team will be installing the system next week.
fill: Next week I ___ following up on the order.
By Friday, the supplier ___ shipped the parts.
I ___ checking the schedule every day.
By Monday, we ___ received all the components.
The team ___ installing the system next week.
By the deadline, we ___ finished the purchase.
At 3 p.m. I ___ meeting the supplier.
By December, they ___ delivered every part.
qa: What will you be doing next week?
I will be following up on the orders.
When will the shipment arrive?
It will have arrived by Friday.
Will you be checking the schedule?
Yes, I will be checking it every day.
Will the parts be here by the deadline?
Yes, they will have arrived before the deadline.
What will the team be doing next month?
They will be installing the new system.
sentences: Next week I will be following up on the order.
By Friday, the supplier will have shipped the parts.
I will be checking the delivery schedule every day.
By the end of the month, we will have received all components.
The team will be installing the system next week.
By the deadline, we will have finished the purchase.
At 3 p.m. I will be meeting the supplier.
By December, they will have delivered every part.
grammarPoint: Future Continuous (will be + verbo-ing) fala de uma ação em andamento no futuro. Future Perfect (will have + particípio) fala de uma ação concluída antes de um momento futuro. I will be checking the order. — Estarei verificando o pedido. By Friday we will have received it. — Até sexta, teremos recebido.
deepDive: Use will be doing para uma ação em progresso ('estarei fazendo'). Use will have done para algo terminado antes de um prazo ('terei feito'). O Future Perfect quase sempre vem com by (by Friday, by the deadline). Dica: se há um prazo, pense em will have done.
examples: I will be following up on the order.
Estarei acompanhando o pedido.
By Friday, we will have shipped the parts.
Até sexta, teremos enviado as peças.
The team will be installing the filter.
A equipe estará instalando o filtro.
By Monday, they will have delivered the valves.
Até segunda, terão entregado as válvulas.
I will be checking the schedule at noon.
Estarei verificando o cronograma ao meio-dia.
By the deadline, we will have finished the order.
Até o prazo, teremos concluído o pedido.
She will be meeting the supplier tomorrow.
Ela estará se reunindo com o fornecedor amanhã.
By next week, the invoice will have arrived.
Até a próxima semana, a fatura terá chegado.
We will be tracking the shipment all week.
Estaremos rastreando a remessa a semana toda.
By December, we will have received everything.
Até dezembro, teremos recebido tudo.
mistakes: I will following up tomorrow.
I will be following up tomorrow.
Future Continuous precisa de be antes do verbo-ing.
By Friday we will received the parts.
By Friday we will have received the parts.
Future Perfect usa will have + particípio.
We will have ship the order.
We will have shipped the order.
Depois de will have use o particípio (shipped).
At 3 p.m. I will meet the supplier all afternoon.
At 3 p.m. I will be meeting the supplier.
Para ação em andamento, use will be meeting.
Until Friday we will have finished.
By Friday we will have finished.
Com Future Perfect use by, não until.
quick: Next week I ___ following up on the order.
By Friday, they ___ shipped the parts.
By Monday, we ___ received the components.
The team ___ installing the system soon.

celebrate.en: Excellent work. Planning the future in English is a real professional skill, and you just showed it.
celebrate.pt: Excelente trabalho. Planejar o futuro em inglês é uma habilidade profissional de verdade, e você acabou de mostrá-la.

title: Reporting what happened with an order
grammar: Past Continuous + Past Simple — while / when
objective: Nesta aula você vai aprender a contar o que estava acontecendo (past continuous) quando algo aconteceu (past simple), usando while e when. Em Compras, isso é útil para relatar atrasos, problemas de entrega e o que estava sendo feito quando um fornecedor ligou ou um material chegou.
intro: Sometimes things happen during a task: a supplier calls while you are reviewing a quotation, or a delivery arrives when you are in a meeting.
Today we learn to join two past actions with while and when. This helps you report delays and events clearly to your team at Delta Ducon.
introAudio: Hi, I am Diego from Procurement. While I was checking the order, the supplier called. When the truck arrived, we were still in a meeting. Let us learn to tell these stories in English.
vocab: There was a delay while we were waiting for parts.
The truck arrived when I was at lunch.
I was writing the report when the phone rang.
The negotiation was going well when the price changed.
The supplier raised the price while we were talking.
We were reading the contract when the manager came in.
practice: There was a ______ while we were waiting for the valves.
The ______ arrived when I was at lunch.
I was writing the ______ when the phone rang.
The ______ was going well when the price changed.
The supplier raised the ______ while we were talking.
We were reading the ______ when the manager came in.
The ______ from Uberlândia was two days late.
We signed the ______ when both sides agreed.

audio.title: What happened during the order
audio.text: While I was reviewing the quotation, the supplier called about a delay. When the truck arrived, we were still checking the schedule. The manager came in while I was writing the report. When the price changed, we were already in the negotiation. So while everyone was working, small problems appeared. When we finally finished, everyone was tired but happy.

readAloud: While I was reviewing the quotation, the supplier called.
When the truck arrived, we were checking the schedule.
The manager came in while I was writing the report.
When the price changed, we were in the negotiation.
While we were waiting, the parts finally arrived.
fill: While I ___ reviewing the order, the supplier called.
When the truck arrived, we ___ checking the schedule.
The manager came in while I ___ writing the report.
When the price ___, we were in the negotiation.
While we ___ waiting, the parts arrived.
I ___ reading the contract when the phone rang.
They ___ loading the truck when it started to rain.
When she called, I ___ checking the invoice.
qa: What were you doing when the supplier called?
I was reviewing the quotation when he called.
What happened while you were in the meeting?
The truck arrived while I was in the meeting.
Why was the order late?
There was a delay while we were waiting for parts.
What were you doing when the price changed?
We were in the negotiation when the price changed.
Who came in while you were writing the report?
The manager came in while I was writing it.
sentences: While I was reviewing the quotation, the supplier called.
When the truck arrived, we were checking the schedule.
The manager came in while I was writing the report.
When the price changed, we were in the negotiation.
While we were waiting, the parts finally arrived.
I was reading the contract when the phone rang.
They were loading the truck when it started to rain.
When she called, I was checking the invoice.
grammarPoint: Use o Past Continuous (was/were + verbo-ing) para a ação longa em andamento, e o Past Simple para a ação curta que a interrompe. While costuma vir com a ação longa; when com a curta. While I was working, the supplier called. — Enquanto eu trabalhava, o fornecedor ligou.
deepDive: A ação longa (was/were doing) é o fundo da cena; a ação curta (called, arrived) acontece nesse meio. Regra prática: while + past continuous, when + past simple. Lembre: I/he/she/it usam was; you/we/they usam were.
examples: While I was reviewing the order, he called.
Enquanto eu revisava o pedido, ele ligou.
When the truck arrived, we were in a meeting.
Quando o caminhão chegou, estávamos em reunião.
The manager came in while I was writing.
O gerente entrou enquanto eu escrevia.
When the price changed, we were negotiating.
Quando o preço mudou, estávamos negociando.
While we were waiting, the parts arrived.
Enquanto esperávamos, as peças chegaram.
I was reading the contract when she called.
Eu estava lendo o contrato quando ela ligou.
They were loading the truck when it rained.
Eles estavam carregando o caminhão quando choveu.
When the delay happened, we were on schedule.
Quando o atraso aconteceu, estávamos no prazo.
While the supplier was talking, I took notes.
Enquanto o fornecedor falava, eu anotava.
When the invoice arrived, we were checking stock.
Quando a fatura chegou, checávamos o estoque.
mistakes: While I reviewing the order, he called.
While I was reviewing the order, he called.
Past Continuous precisa de was/were antes do verbo-ing.
When the truck arrived, we was in a meeting.
When the truck arrived, we were in a meeting.
Com we use were, não was.
While the supplier called, I was writing.
When the supplier called, I was writing.
A ação curta pede when, não while.
I was write the report when she came.
I was writing the report when she came.
Depois de was, use o verbo com -ing.
When I was checking, the truck was arriving.
When I was checking, the truck arrived.
A ação curta que interrompe fica no Past Simple.
quick: While I ___ reviewing the order, he called.
When the truck arrived, we ___ in a meeting.
I ___ writing the report when she came.
They ___ loading the truck when it rained.
When the phone rang, I ___ checking stock.

celebrate.en: Great job. You can now tell the story of an order clearly, even when things do not go as planned.
celebrate.pt: Ótimo trabalho. Agora você consegue contar a história de um pedido com clareza, mesmo quando as coisas não saem como o planejado.

title: Learning from past purchasing decisions
grammar: Third Conditional — if + past perfect, would have
objective: Nesta aula você vai aprender o Third Conditional para falar de situações passadas que não aconteceram e suas consequências imaginárias. Em Compras, isso ajuda a analisar decisões: o que teria acontecido se você tivesse escolhido outro fornecedor, negociado antes ou pedido mais material.
intro: In Procurement we often look back and think: if we had ordered earlier, we would have avoided the delay.
Today we learn the Third Conditional. It helps you review past decisions and explain what would have happened with a different choice at Delta Ducon.
introAudio: Hi, I am Elisa from Procurement. If we had compared more quotations, we would have saved money. If the supplier had called, we would have known about the delay. Let us practise this together.
vocab: If we had made a better decision, we would have saved time.
If we had checked the budget, we would have known the limit.
If we had ordered earlier, we would have avoided the backorder.
If we had negotiated, we would have got a discount.
If the supplier had answered, we would have signed the deal.
If we had bought more, we would have avoided the shortage.
practice: If we had made a better ______, we would have saved time.
If we had checked the ______, we would have known the limit.
If we had ordered earlier, we would have avoided the ______.
If we had negotiated, we would have got a ______.
If the ______ had answered, we would have signed the deal.
If we had bought more, we would have avoided the ______.
A late ______ would have cost us the whole project.
A good ______ would have made the price lower.

audio.title: A review of last month's orders
audio.text: If we had compared more quotations, we would have found a better price. If the supplier had called earlier, we would have known about the delay. If we had ordered the valves in March, we would have avoided the backorder. The project would have finished on time if we had planned better. If we had negotiated harder, we would have got a bigger discount. We learned a lot, and next time we will do better.

readAloud: If we had ordered earlier, we would have avoided the delay.
If the supplier had called, we would have known sooner.
If we had negotiated, we would have got a discount.
If we had checked the budget, we would have saved money.
The project would have finished if we had planned better.
fill: If we ___ ordered earlier, we would have avoided the delay.
If the supplier had called, we ___ have known sooner.
If we had negotiated, we would ___ got a discount.
If we ___ checked the budget, we would have saved money.
The project would have finished if we ___ planned better.
If we had bought more, we ___ have avoided the shortage.
If they had shipped on time, we ___ have installed the system.
We would have signed if the supplier ___ answered.
qa: What would have happened if we had ordered earlier?
We would have avoided the delay.
Would we have saved money with more quotations?
Yes, we would have found a better price.
What if the supplier had called sooner?
We would have known about the problem.
Would we have got a discount with a better negotiation?
Yes, we would have got a bigger discount.
What would have happened if we had checked the budget?
We would have stayed within the limit.
sentences: If we had ordered earlier, we would have avoided the delay.
If the supplier had called, we would have known sooner.
If we had negotiated, we would have got a better discount.
If we had checked the budget, we would have saved money.
The project would have finished if we had planned better.
If we had bought more valves, we would have avoided the shortage.
If they had shipped on time, we would have installed the system.
We would have signed the deal if the supplier had answered.
grammarPoint: O Third Conditional fala de um passado que não aconteceu. Estrutura: If + past perfect (had + particípio), would have + particípio. If we had ordered earlier, we would have avoided the delay. — Se tivéssemos pedido antes, teríamos evitado o atraso.
deepDive: Use o Third Conditional para imaginar um resultado diferente no passado. A parte com if usa had + particípio; a parte do resultado usa would have + particípio. Nada disso aconteceu de verdade — é uma reflexão. Dica: pense 'se eu tivesse... eu teria...'.
examples: If we had ordered earlier, we would have avoided the delay.
Se tivéssemos pedido antes, teríamos evitado o atraso.
If the supplier had called, we would have known.
Se o fornecedor tivesse ligado, teríamos sabido.
If we had negotiated, we would have got a discount.
Se tivéssemos negociado, teríamos conseguido um desconto.
If we had checked the budget, we would have saved money.
Se tivéssemos verificado o orçamento, teríamos economizado.
If they had shipped on time, we would have finished.
Se eles tivessem enviado no prazo, teríamos terminado.
If we had bought more, we would have avoided the shortage.
Se tivéssemos comprado mais, teríamos evitado a escassez.
If I had known, I would have told you.
Se eu tivesse sabido, teria te avisado.
If the price had been lower, we would have ordered.
Se o preço tivesse sido menor, teríamos pedido.
If we had compared quotations, we would have chosen better.
Se tivéssemos comparado cotações, teríamos escolhido melhor.
The project would have succeeded if we had planned better.
O projeto teria dado certo se tivéssemos planejado melhor.
mistakes: If we had ordered earlier, we would avoided the delay.
If we had ordered earlier, we would have avoided the delay.
O resultado precisa de would have + particípio.
If we would have ordered, we would have saved.
If we had ordered, we would have saved.
Na parte do if use had, não would have.
If we had order earlier, we would have saved.
If we had ordered earlier, we would have saved.
Depois de had, use o particípio (ordered).
If the supplier called, we would have known.
If the supplier had called, we would have known.
Third Conditional pede had called, não called.
We would have got a discount if we negotiate.
We would have got a discount if we had negotiated.
A parte do if fica no past perfect (had negotiated).
quick: If we ___ ordered earlier, we would have saved time.
If the supplier had called, we ___ have known.
If we had negotiated, we would ___ got a discount.
The project would have finished if we ___ planned better.
If they had shipped on time, we ___ have installed it.

celebrate.en: Impressive work. Reviewing past decisions in English will make you a sharper professional in Procurement.
celebrate.pt: Trabalho impressionante. Analisar decisões passadas em inglês vai tornar você um profissional mais afiado em Compras.

title: Business phrasal verbs in Procurement
grammar: Business phrasal verbs — follow up, carry out, set up, deal with, look into
objective: Nesta aula você vai aprender phrasal verbs muito usados no dia a dia de Compras: follow up, carry out, set up, deal with e look into. Eles deixam seus e-mails e ligações mais naturais quando você acompanha pedidos, resolve problemas com fornecedores e organiza processos na Delta Ducon.
intro: Every day in Procurement you follow up on orders, deal with suppliers, and look into problems.
Today we learn the most useful business phrasal verbs. They will make your emails and calls sound natural and professional at Delta Ducon.
introAudio: Hi, I am Fabio from Procurement. Every day I follow up on orders, deal with suppliers, and look into delivery problems. Let us learn these phrasal verbs together.
vocab: I will follow up on the order tomorrow.
We carry out a quality check on every part.
Let us set up a meeting with the supplier.
I deal with three suppliers every week.
I will look into the delivery delay.
We need to sort out the invoice problem.
practice: I will ______ on the order tomorrow morning.
We ______ a quality check on every component.
Let us ______ a meeting with the supplier.
Please ______ the delivery delay and report back.
We need to ______ the invoice problem today.
Can you ______ on the quotation you sent?
The manager will ______ the price increase.

audio.title: A busy day in Procurement
audio.text: This morning I need to follow up on two orders. First, I will set up a call with the supplier in Uberlândia. Then I will look into the delay with the filter shipment. My colleague will carry out the quality check on the new valves. We always deal with problems quickly, so the customer stays happy. If any invoice is wrong, we sort it out the same day.

readAloud: I will follow up on the order tomorrow.
We carry out a quality check on every part.
Let us set up a meeting with the supplier.
I deal with several suppliers every week.
I will look into the delivery delay.
fill: I will ___ on the order tomorrow.
We ___ a quality check on every part.
Let us ___ a meeting with the supplier.
We need to ___ the invoice problem.
The team will ___ the inspection tomorrow.
qa: What will you do about the order?
I will follow up on it tomorrow.
Who carries out the quality check?
My colleague carries out the quality check.
Can you set up a meeting with the supplier?
Yes, I will set up a call this afternoon.
How do you handle problems with suppliers?
We deal with them quickly and politely.
What will you do about the delay?
I will look into the delay and report back.
sentences: I will follow up on the order tomorrow.
We carry out a quality check on every component.
Let us set up a meeting with the supplier.
I deal with several suppliers every week.
I will look into the delivery delay today.
We need to sort out the invoice problem.
Please follow up on the quotation you sent.
The team will carry out the inspection tomorrow.
grammarPoint: Phrasal verbs são verbos com uma partícula que muda o sentido. Follow up = acompanhar; carry out = executar; set up = organizar; deal with = lidar com; look into = investigar. I will follow up on the order. — Vou acompanhar o pedido. We deal with suppliers. — Lidamos com fornecedores.
deepDive: Alguns phrasal verbs pedem preposição depois: follow up on, look into, deal with. Outros aceitam o objeto no meio: set up a meeting ou set a meeting up. Dica: memorize o phrasal verb junto com a preposição que costuma acompanhar (follow up ON, look INTO).
examples: I will follow up on the order.
Vou acompanhar o pedido.
We carry out a quality check.
Realizamos uma verificação de qualidade.
Let us set up a meeting.
Vamos organizar uma reunião.
I deal with several suppliers.
Eu lido com vários fornecedores.
I will look into the delay.
Vou investigar o atraso.
We need to sort out the invoice.
Precisamos resolver a fatura.
Please follow up on the quotation.
Por favor, acompanhe a cotação.
The team will carry out the inspection.
A equipe vai realizar a inspeção.
She set up a call with the supplier.
Ela organizou uma ligação com o fornecedor.
We deal with problems quickly.
Nós lidamos com os problemas rapidamente.
mistakes: I will follow up the order.
I will follow up on the order.
Follow up costuma pedir a preposição on.
I will look the delay.
I will look into the delay.
Look into precisa de into para significar investigar.
We deal the suppliers.
We deal with the suppliers.
Deal with sempre leva with.
Let us set up meeting.
Let us set up a meeting.
Não esqueça o artigo: set up a meeting.
We carry the inspection.
We carry out the inspection.
É carry out; sem out muda o sentido.
quick: I will ___ on the order tomorrow.
We ___ a quality check every day.

celebrate.en: Outstanding. These phrasal verbs will make your daily English in Procurement sound confident and natural.
celebrate.pt: Excelente. Esses phrasal verbs vão deixar o seu inglês do dia a dia em Compras mais confiante e natural.
